craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta of landing — rest, fulfillment, no-other-standing; autonomy dawning mid-proof. Verbless nominal lines kept verbless (L3 note + SA verblessness): no verbs smuggled — agency withheld is the point; end-weight unbroken. Rejected: (a) adding is/measured verbs → killed: verbs would import what the verse withholds. (b) atom→particle → killed: aṇu load term. Read aloud: ONE-self, TWO-fold: MEA-sured AND-un-MEA-sured — … su-PREME-self, un-BRO-ken.

lines: One self, twofold: measured and unmeasured —
breath-bound, an atom; supreme self, unbroken.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dvidhā sa eṣa evātmā mito 'parimitas tathā prāṇādinā niruddho 'ṇuḥ paramātmā tv akhaṇḍitaḥ
notes: both lines nominal, mirroring verbless SA (dvidhā … niruddho 'ṇuḥ … akhaṇḍitaḥ)

reads_against.argmap: How is the self both bound and free? → One self, two measures — contracted atom, unbroken whole: play (krīḍā), not split.
c1_essence: What never stood cannot stand another: consciousness fits itself to this and I, orders inert selves by double certainty, and completes severed grasping in self-rest (vv10-15).
The same self twofold — breath-bound atom, unbroken whole — gathers in one continuous end-ground where nothing shows more inert than shining (vv16-18).
